statutes.title: Persons Subject to Tax - Rates
text_en: Imposes graduated individual income tax rates of 3.75%, 4.75%, and 5.99% on federal adjusted gross income in Rhode Island.
text_es: Impone tasas de impuesto sobre el ingreso individual del 3.75%, 4.75% y 5.99% sobre el ingreso bruto ajustado federal en Rhode Island.
